Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:
hi there =)
lots of questions about our fellow caitiffs!

Mukhtar Bey, prince of Cairo decides to go on progeny.
he creates and put in play a 1 cap Caitiff, right ?

now smudge decides to go on thin blooded seering.
he creates and put in play a 1 cap clanless camarilla, right ?
is this thin blooded seer Caitiff too ? (since he's clanless and camarilla,
as stated in the rulebook)
it's important since i may want to play revelation of the sire on him later
to let him become, say, Nagaraja.

what if i play diversity if i control ony caitiffs and thin blooded seers ?
guess i gain 0 pool ?

and if i have one nagaraja and one caitiff ?
do i gain 0, 1 or 2 pool ? :)

thank you !

reyda

Good so far.

>now smudge decides to go on thin blooded seering.
>he creates and put in play a 1 cap clanless camarilla, right ?

Still good.

>is this thin blooded seer Caitiff too ?

No.

Caitiff is a designator that is not inhereted by being clanless and
Camarilla.

See the parallel with the Great Beast and a Writ of Acceptance.

LSJ 2002-09-17
http://groups.google.com/groups?selm=3D87729F.9325C57E%40white-wolf.com

>(since he's clanless and camarilla, as stated in the rulebook)
>it's important since i may want to play revelation of the sire on him later
>to let him become, say, Nagaraja.

Not gonna happen legally. Sorry.

>what if i play diversity if i control ony caitiffs and thin blooded seers ?
>guess i gain 0 pool ?

Correct.

Caitiff are not a clan, and thin-blooded seers are not a clan.
You would control 0 unique clans.

>and if i have one nagaraja and one caitiff ?
>do i gain 0, 1 or 2 pool ? :)

You would gain 1 pool.
You would control 1 unique clan.

Caitiff. I would lean towards yes, though, but IANLSJ.

> what if i play diversity if i control ony caitiffs and thin blooded seers ?

Yes. Caitiff is not a clan, and so isn't counted for diversify.

1.

--Colin McGuigan
